snippet.title: AOKAKI - Gameplay Trailer | Galaxies Autumn 2026 Showcase
snippet.description:
Find this game and every game from Galaxies Spring on our Steam Event page - https://store.steampowered.com/news/group/45348822/view/719040453611095010

You play Aokaki, a tokusatsu-inspired isopod ronin, through a feudal land of insect enemies. You parry, deflect and pogo your way through stages and rebuild your ruined homeland along the way. It's a 2D pixel-art platformer from a small team in Brazil.
